name: Voice DSP+ V2 USB and I2S firmware catalog

firmwares.label: V2 - USB Mono 48 kHz - 0.8.9-r4
firmwares.description: USB sound card. Validated mono AEC, automatic microphone geometry, Windows volume, gestures, speaker selection and persistent output/volume. Stop playback before updating.

firmwares.label: V2 - I2S 48 kHz - Host-controlled (UI2)
firmwares.description: Switch to the accepted host-controlled I2S application (unchanged HA XMOS image). USB audio and browser updating disappear after reboot. A host must initialize audio. To return to USB, use ZeroCore S3 USB Recovery or Raspberry Pi/SPI provisioning. This new USB-to-I2S update path has not yet been tested on hardware.
